name: test-oracle-independence
description: Use when you are about to write tests for code that already exists, especially code you or another agent just wrote and that is sitting in your context. A test is an oracle only if it is independent of the code it checks: tests written with a faulty implementation in view repeat the fault in their assertions, so code and tests agree and are both wrong. Take every expected value from the specification (requirement, acceptance criteria, docstring contract, domain invariant), never from what the code currently returns; if no specification exists, write one first; label any test that pins current behaviour as a characterization test. Distinct from test-generator (test structure and naming) and execution-grounded-selection (choosing among candidates by running them). Backed by arxiv 2607.05139 and arxiv 2607.22883. Triggers on writing tests after the implementation and on reviewing agent-written tests.
